validation.invalid_lines: Name at least one item to return
validation.duplicate_variant: An item can appear only once per return - state its quantity instead
validation.price_vat_pair: State the price and the VAT rate together, or neither for a free return

error.invalid_line: Variant #{{variant_id}} is not on this order
error.over_returnable: Only {{remaining}} of variant #{{variant_id}} were delivered and are not already being returned
error.order_not_returnable: Only a confirmed or completed order can have goods returned
error.window_closed: Returns can be requested up to {{days}} days after delivery - this order is past that
error.status_changed: The return changed status while it was being edited - reload it and try again
error.decided_locked: The return has been decided - only the notes and the response can still change
error.return_in_transit: The goods are already on their way back - the return can no longer be canceled
error.refund_not_received: A refund is drafted once the returned goods have arrived
error.refund_already_raised: A refund has already been drafted for this return
error.nothing_to_refund: Nothing to refund - no issued invoice of the order billed these goods, or they were already reversed
error.delete_locked: An approved return has moved goods and money - it cannot be deleted
error.wrong_warehouse: Variant #{{variant_id}} was not delivered from warehouse #{{warehouse_id}} - a stocked item goes back to the warehouse it left from
error.destination_required: None of these goods left from a warehouse on a delivered delivery - state the warehouse they go back to
error.cancel_decided: The return has already been decided and can no longer be withdrawn

success.request: Return requested - we will let you know once it is reviewed
success.approve: Return approved - the return shipment was created
success.refund: Refund drafted - issue the reversal to pay it back

history.deleted: Return(s) {{entity_ids}} marked as deleted by user #{{auth_id}}
history.status: Return #{{entity_id}} updated from {{oldStatus}} to {{newStatus}} by user #{{auth_id}}
